## Substantive repairs (proof defects found by reading the arguments)
1. **`thm-two-step-generic-factorization-and-ccc`** (fatal): step 2.1 claimed ccc of `P` yields a condition forcing uncountably many indices into the generic — false (the index set is countable in every extension). Rewrote with the correct bounded-index argument (ccc quotient ⇒ countable index set; density + ccc ⇒ uniform bound; contradiction).
2. **`thm-ma-small-unions-of-null-sets`**: the ccc step required a nonexistent "common positive slack"; replaced by per-condition inner rational approximations with slack `(ε−m(U))/2`.
3. **`thm-fraenkel-mostowski-permutation-model`**: "atoms are fixed by every permutation" is false; replaced with the correct symmetry reason.
4. **`thm-hereditarily-symmetric-interpretations-form-a-zf-model`**: the justification of full Separation/Replacement via a bounded satisfaction recursion cannot evaluate unbounded quantifiers; rewrote it in the standard criterion form (Δ₀-Separation + almost universality ⇒ set-forming operations ⇒ Comprehension, then Replacement).
